title: Completed realization of uniform finite perfect quotient models
statement: Let X be locally Noetherian and quasi-compact [pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], (A,I) an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], with A I-adically complete. Let M be an arbitrary object of D(Mod(B_X)), B_X the inverse limit of the finite quotient sheaves. Suppose its actual normalized derived quotient system has etale local constant finite-projective models with one bound interval on each initial etale chart, as in HasUniformFinitePerfectModels. Then the derived limit of that specified strict quotient system is pro-etale locally B_X tensor_A^L P for a bounded finite-projective A-complex P [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex]. Constant coefficient identifications are commuting with quotient transitions and the completed scalar projections. Completeness of the original M is not assumed, and no identification of M itself with its quotient-system limit is asserted.

source.place: Tag 09C6, lemma-connected-adic-lisse, effectivity of its finite perfect quotient system; More on Algebra Tag 09AW; Cohomology on Sites Tags 0940 and 0941.

proof.text: Apply compatible algebraic stalk extraction to obtain a pro-etale cover and a normalized algebraic quotient diagram with perfect residue, together with an isomorphism of the entire actual restricted diagram.

Construct a Roos limit of the algebraic diagram and apply perfect inverse-limit reconstruction. Choose a bounded finite-projective representative of this perfect limit. Naturality of the levelwise adjunction units transports the canonical reduction maps and their transition equations to this representative.

Apply the specified strict-limit comparison for this compatible finite-projective marking. Exactness of the constant functor identifies its derived value on Q(P) with the termwise constant complex. Compare representative restriction with exact derived restriction using the localization factorization and the representative isomorphism. Compose these isomorphisms.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09C6, separated into compatible stalk extraction, algebraic reconstruction by Tag 09AW, and the finite-projective Roos calculation; W3 proves reconstruction, restriction, specified strict-limit comparison and isomorphism assembly.

lean.statement:
theorem finitePerfectModels_adic_realization
    (X : Scheme.{t}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [CompactSpace X]
    {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    [IsAdicComplete d.ideal A]
    [(koszulConstantFunctor X A).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    [∀ n : ℕ, (koszulConstantFunctor X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, adicConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) ⟶
      completedAdicFiniteCommRing X d n)
    (_hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (φ n)) (_hcompat : FinitePerfectModelsCompatible X d φ)
    (M : DerivedCategory (CompletedAdicModules X d))
    (_hmodels : HasUniformFinitePerfectModels X d φ M) :
    ∃ S : Sieve (⊤_ X.ProEt), S ∈ ProEt.topology X (⊤_ X.ProEt) ∧
      ∀ (U : X.ProEt) (f : U ⟶ ⊤_ X.ProEt), S f →
        ∃ (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{t} A) ℤ) (a b : ℤ),
          P.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ P.IsStrictlyLE b ∧
          (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Projective A (P.X i) ∧ Module.Finite A (P.X i)) ∧
          Nonempty
            (ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses (completedAdicRing X d) U
                ((reconstructionRlim X d).obj ((completedAdicReduction X d).obj M)) ≅
              ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses (completedAdicRing X d) U
                ((completedAdicDerivedChange X (completedAdicScalar X d)).obj
                  (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (finiteModelConstantComplex X A P))))
